hero.title: Women’s Health — acupuncture for women, by women
hero.subtitle: Balance Method acupuncture in a calm, supportive setting
paragraphs: We support women through different life stages—cycle concerns, hormonal transitions, fertility support, pregnancy care, and postpartum recovery.
Each treatment plan is tailored to your symptoms, constitution, and day-to-day life, with thoughtful attention to comfort and privacy.
hero.disclaimer: Acupuncture is supportive care and does not replace medical diagnosis or emergency treatment. For pregnancy-related concerns, always inform your midwife/doctor and share how far along you are so treatment can be adapted.

safety.title: Important note
safety.text: Supportive care only — not a substitute for midwifery/obstetric or emergency care. For severe, sudden, or worsening symptoms, contact your GP or emergency services first.

life_stages_head.title: Support across life stages
life_stages_head.subtitle: Clear focus areas, with tailored planning based on timing and pattern.

life_stages.title: Cycle & PMS support
paragraphs: Cycle discomfort often includes more than pain—it can affect mood, sleep, digestion, and energy. We tailor sessions based on timing, pattern, and what your body needs most right now.

life_stages.title: Menopause & hormonal transition
paragraphs: Hormonal transitions can affect thermoregulation, sleep quality, mood, and stress tolerance. Treatment plans focus on improving comfort and recovery capacity.

life_stages.title: Stress & burnout support
paragraphs: When stress stays “on” too long, the nervous system can become more sensitive—sleep, digestion, pain, and mood often follow. We focus on downshifting the stress response and supporting recovery.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions about women’s health support

items.q: Can I receive acupuncture during pregnancy?
items.a: Yes. Acupuncture can be safely applied during pregnancy when performed by a trained practitioner. Please share how far along you are so treatment can be adapted appropriately.

items.q: What do you need to know before my pregnancy appointment?
items.a: We’ll ask about your main symptoms, how far along you are, your comfort level, and any medical guidance you’ve received. Always keep your midwife/doctor informed.
Yes. Some people choose supportive acupuncture care for recovery and rebalancing after birth. We tailor the plan to your energy, sleep, and comfort needs.

items.q: How many sessions do people usually start with?
items.a: Most people start with a short series. Frequency and duration depend on your symptoms, goals, and how your body responds.

items.q: Can acupuncture be combined with medical care?
items.a: Often, yes. Please let your practitioner know about any ongoing treatments or medications so your plan can be adjusted appropriately.

items.q: What if symptoms are severe or sudden?
items.a: Seek medical care first. Acupuncture is supportive care and does not replace urgent diagnosis or emergency treatment.
